items.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
items.summary: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

items.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
items.summary: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

items.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
items.summary: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

items.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.summary: Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.

items.title: Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
items.summary: The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Bitcoin shows signs of weakness while Ripple's bank win fails to bolster XRP
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 27, 2026

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds below $80,000 as AI buildout draws investor attention and capital
items.summary: Interest rates and oil are slipping and equities are rising, but crypto remains under pressure.

items.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
items.summary: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

items.title: Bitcoin drops below $80,000 as crypto ignores Asian tech rally, Fed meeting begins
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $79,700 since midnight UTC while Asian tech stocks rallied. The DeFi index dropped 1.8%, and the Fed is set to begin a two-day meeting.

items.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
items.summary: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

items.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
items.summary: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

items.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
items.summary: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

items.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
items.summary: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

items.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
items.summary: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

items.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
items.summary: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.

items.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

items.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
items.summary: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.

items.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
items.summary: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

items.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
items.summary: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.
